note.en: When the swarm country is destroyed every empire receives this report; the Sentinels' farewell and feral Prethoryn may follow as aftermath. The scripts contain no ending event for a swarm victory.

notes.zh: 正文按能否理解索林原虫而不同：一般帝国只收到无法翻译的信号；灵能物种或蜂巢思维物种可读出内容。
notes.en: The text depends on whether the empire can understand the Prethoryn: most empires receive an untranslatable signal; psionic or hive-minded species can read it.

notes.zh: 这是外交界面中的可重复通讯，不是剧情的下一步。能否理解虫群取决于 can_talk_to_prethoryn：灵能物种、蜂巢思维物种，或拥有巨兽之怒威胁特质“心灵融合”。
notes.en: A repeatable diplomacy screen, not the next story step. Understanding the swarm depends on can_talk_to_prethoryn: a psionic or hive-minded species, or the Behemoth Fury menace perk Mind Meld.

notes.zh: 各选项只按政府主导思潮与狂热思潮区分，内容都是开启“虚空之鞭”事件链。
notes.en: The options differ only by governing and fanatic ethics; every option starts the Scourge of the Void event chain.

scope.en: Checked every visible event of crisis_events_1.txt with its triggers, hidden routers and delays, plus the observer copies, Custodian/Emperor announcements, relic and project.

uncertain: MTTH values are engine means evaluated per qualifying country per month; real waiting times vary and are shown only as the script values.
crisis.16: an empire that can talk to the Prethoryn only through the Mind Meld perk matches none of the three desc triggers (L320-337); what the game then displays was not verified in play.
